entities.summary: Uche Frances Nwaefuna, professionally known as Uche Montana, is a Nigerian actress, model, screenwriter, film producer, and digital content creator. She gained prominence following her role in the Africa wisdom television series Hush (2016–2017), which earned her the MAYA Awards Africa for Best Supporting Actress in a TV Series.
